text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Fest has arrived,<n>and the entire
area is jam-packed<n>with people. Peeking through
the<n>crowd, I spot familiar faces by the<n>gate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Reports of lost children are on the<n>rise. Please be
extra careful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you don't know where to go, find<n>an
Umamusume! Just look for—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —ears like these, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —a tail like this!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please let us know if there is anything<n>else you
require.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh! This pose... It's so hard to keep<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I know. It's meant to be<n>visually appealing,
but it is rather<n>awkward.
choice_data_list: I see you're taking your guide job seriously.
I see you're taking your guide job seriously.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahh?! I'm right here to help you!<n>Don't be scared!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Calm down, Spe. You're not<n>talking with a
lost child.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, you're—Grass's trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... You aren't lost, then? What a<n>rel—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaah! Big Brotherrrr!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my! But this little girl actually does<n>seem lost.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: L-l-lost?! Then it's our job to—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-where'd she go?! ...Graaass?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I see... You became separated<n>from your older
brother, yes?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... He ran off somewhere... And<n>now I can't
find him...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... This way, madam! Yourdaughter's right over here!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mommy?!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! I was looking all<n>around for you!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much... And I<n>believe someone
else has something<n>to say as well?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. She can stay lost for all I<n>care.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Goodness...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You know, your sister was calling for<n>you this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
And? She's a loud, annoying brat,<n>and I wish she'd
go away!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't talk about your sister like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll just volunteer to take<n>your place and
become her "big<n>sister."

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd be so happy to have another cute<n>little sister
around. Hehehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Wha? B-Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: S-stop! Where do you think you'retaking her?! She's my sister!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess someone wants to be<n>a big brother
now after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spilled water never returns... There's<n>no erasing
words once said.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If there's something you hold dear,<n>you should
take proper actions to<n>preserve it.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: W-we made up, okay?! What more do<n>you want?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Just for you to run along and<n>have fun
together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you flatter me. It's only proper to<n>be a good role
model for those<n>younger than you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though I must say, being strict for a<n>child's sake
does sting inside.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll quietly accept your words<n>of appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her conflicting feelings, Grass<n>Wonder
does an excellent job as a<n>guide, staying firm,
polite, and true to<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Just for you to run along and<n>have fun
together!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! ...C'mon, where are we going<n>next?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, anywhere you want!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeesh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it makes me a little jealous. His<n>younger sister
clearly adores him<n>dearly...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Eheh. Perhaps I'll call my sister<n>tonight. It's been
so long since we<n>spoke.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me. Have I never told you<n>about her?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must not have mentioned it, but I'm<n>an older
sister.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ♪ My sister's such an<n>excellent student,
she even got<n>invited to a boarding school back in<n>the
States.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From there, I sit through nearly an<n>hour of Grass
gushing about her little<n>sister in America.
